facebook.caption:
This place fixes something in you.

Dinh Cậu is a small shrine to the sea goddess, perched on a rock above the harbor. Blue-and-white striped lighthouse behind it. Fishing boats drifting in below. The whole scene hits different at sunset.

4.5 stars across 3,613 reviews. Go at dusk. Sit with it.
